18.text: wind, ˙eˊwtelan (“down-[stream wind]”) for the south-southwest wind, onm-eˊwtelan (“inner down-
18.resolved: eˊwtelan = e, ˊ=U+02CA, w, t, e, l, a, n (both occurrences); the first occurrence is preceded by a raised dot keyed U+02D9, position unlicensed — see note
18.note: FLAG FOR HUMAN — the one thing on this page needing a ruling. The first ˙eˊwtelan carries a small raised dot immediately BEFORE its initial e, mid-x-height, same weight as the stress mark, confirmed at 4x. The second occurrence in the same line, onm-eˊwtelan, has no such dot. That contrast is on the paper and is the finding; what the dot MEANS is not proposed here. keying_spec §2.1 catalogues a raised dot as U+02D9, the palatalization mark, but licenses it only POSTPOSED after n x d t s č ǰ — so the letterform is inventory, the position is not. Keyed U+02D9 because it is the catalogued sort whose shape this is; the environment is the open question and only a human may settle it. An earlier draft of this proposal keyed U+00B7 as a "closest visual match": that is wrong and was corrected — §2.7 lists U+00B7 as a lookalike TRAP for U+02D9, i.e. a character with no legitimate reading anywhere in the corpus, and it is zero-attested across gt/ocr. Separately, both eˊwtelan stress marks sit after e and before w, not a licensed apostrophe environment, so U+02CA.
